paragraphs: In Shabbat 80b, he came to Babylonia and was asked to expound the Account of the Chariot. He replied, “I will expound for you as Rabbi Nechemyah expounded.” Hyman explains that this is not a personal name but means a man of Galilee.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman explains Bar Gelila as a Galilean designation, not a personal name.

The consulted Shabbat 80b paragraph includes Bar Gelila’s arrival, the request to expound the chariot, and his response invoking Rabbi Nechemyah. Hyman’s explanation of Bar Gelila as a Galilean designation is retained as his explanation, without binding it to a separate person.
